The main takeaway from our work is that
a common Lyapunov or Lyapunovlike function for all subsystem matrices is guaranteed if a Lie algebra generated from these matrices is solvable.
the Lie algebra generated by a set of matrices is an important tool for analyzing stability for switched systems.
